# Christy Sports

> > Winter sports retailer specializing in ski and snowboard rentals, sales, and repairs across Colorado, Utah, Montana, and Washington mountain destinations.

Christy Sports operates retail locations and rental shops at major ski resorts including Vail, Aspen, Park City, Deer Valley, Snowbird, and Big Sky. The company offers daily and season rentals, equipment sales from brands like Atomic and Black Diamond, custom boot fitting, repair services, and outdoor gear including patio furniture through their Leisure Living division.

## Key Topics

- Ski rentals
- Snowboard rentals
- Equipment packages
- Daily and season rentals
- Colorado resort locations (Vail, Aspen, Telluride, Beaver Creek)
- Utah ski areas (Park City, Deer Valley, Snowbird, Salt Lake City)
- Montana (Big Sky)
- Washington locations
- Custom boot fitting
- Equipment repairs
- Rental delivery
- Try Before You Buy demos
- Winter sports gear
- Outdoor apparel
